notes.title: NEW PATCH FOR HELLGATE SENIGALLIA REMAKE
notes.content:
[b]NEW PATCH FOR HELLGATE SENIGALLIA REMAKE[/b]

I’ve listened to the community ([i]much love, you mean everything to me[/i]) and made several updates and changes:

[list]
[*][b]Optimized textures[/b] (should run much smoother now)
[*][b]Increased player speed[/b]
[*][b]Changed "Action" key label to "E"[/b]
[*][b]Improved petophone tutorial[/b]
[*][b]Improved collectibles/tablet tutorial[/b]
[*][b]Enhanced HUD[/b] (status effect and money icons now appear above health)
[*][b]Haunted villa Polaroid now available in the tablet[/b]
[*][b]You can now climb turrets from any side in the final level[/b]
[*][b]Improved AI[/b] for Police Robots and Raga in the final level
[*][b]Added interface for rescuing friends in the final level[/b]
[*][b]Menu selections now in red for better visibility[/b]
[*][b]Reshade included in the folder[/b] (currently in testing, let me know if everything works.
To customize, press [i]Home[/i] on your keyboard.
Three presets are included, but feel free to experiment, create new ones, and share them in the hub.
If you want to disable it, simply uncheck the effect boxes.)
[*][b]Various fixes and improvements[/b]
[/list]

As always, let me know what you think and have fun!  
[i]Unfortunately, some save files may not work.[/i]

notes.title: New startup options
notes.content:
New startup options have been implemented for users who experienced issues with the initial launcher management. You can now bypass it by directly selecting your preferred language, which will automatically launch the game. A heartfelt thank you to user BlackMarks, who brought this previously unknown issue to my attention. The important thing is to always find a solution for everyone!

Cheers and have a great weekend!

Rick Dope

Secret button: discover a way to skip levels and dive straight into the next massacre.

If you’re ready to crush skulls, rip guts, and obliterate abominations in a storm of unrelenting violence, Hellgate Senigallia Remake is waiting for you. More blood, less cash.

Download it now and let hell quake.

notes.title: Hellgate Senigallia Remake
notes.content:
Get ready to face hell on Steam!
[b]Hellgate Senigallia Remake – Available from November 29, 2024![/b]

Senigallia has fallen, the gates of hell have opened, and you’re the only hope for a city devastated by ruthless demons and otherworldly abominations. Take on waves of ravenous creatures in a first-person shooter drenched in blood and violence, with devastating weapons and nightmarish settings!

[b]Key Features:[/b]

Adrenaline-pumping gameplay with demons, gut-spilling action, and total destruction.
Environments inspired by the historic city of Senigallia, now reduced to an infernal battleground.
Thrilling action, detailed graphics, and an atmosphere that will keep you on edge.
Join us on Steam from November 29 and fight to save humanity... if you can!
